news.detail: Cleared concussion protocol Sunday; no game status designation for Monday night, upgraded from questionable.
With Caleb Williams out, starting QB could be a game-time decision between Bagent and Case Keenum.
Knee injury; full participant in Friday practice and carries no game designation.
Limited early in week with a stinger; practiced in full Saturday and is not on the final injury report.
Missed Thursday with hamstring issue, practiced fully Saturday; no designation, will play.
With Goedert out, Mundt is one of three TEs alongside elevated Zach Ertz and E.J. Jenkins; Ertz's role may limit him.
